text_block_list.text:
As the new year arrived and Hokko Tarumae's
Classic Year was about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes our meeting.
Thank you very much for your hard work and time today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work!
I look forward to continuing to work with you!
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
—Hokko Tarumae returned home to Tomakomai to visit family
and hold meetings for her solo event this spring.

"And as her Trainer, I was present
at the meeting as well, confirming
various details."

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for widely promoting our year-end event on social media the other day. The management team was thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, please...! I merely did what any local idol should!
If anything, if only I had more reach—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text:
No, Hokko Tarumae has been far more
of a help to us than she realizes.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Tourism Association Staff
text_block_list.text:
Do your best in the Classic year of the Twinkle Series!
As a citizen of Tomakomai and as one of your fans,
I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
I'll do my absolute best to live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Our meeting ended much quicker
than I expected, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, did you say you booked
a room by the station?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you'd like,
would you care to join me for lunch after this?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Since you went out of your way to come all the way to Tomakomai, Trainer, I really wanted to show you some delicious places to eat—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!
Then let's go right away!

Guided by Hokko Tarumae,
we made our way toward the harbor where the shop was said to be—

text_block_list.name: Port Worker A
text_block_list.text:
—Well if it isn't Tarumae-chan!
You're back in town! How've you been doing?

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Tarumae-chan? Oh my!
It's been so long! Welcome home!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm back!
I'm so glad to see you and Uncle doing well.

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
I'm overflowing with energy~!
Tarumae-chan is working so hard racing on the mainland all by herself.
So this auntie can't afford to fall behind either!

text_block_list.name: Port Worker A
text_block_list.text:
Could the person next to you
be Tarumae-chan's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome, all the way from so far away~!
There isn't much here, but please make yourself at home."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, lady!
How can you say that right in front
of an official tourism ambassador?!

text_block_list.name: Port Worker A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, totally! Tomakomai has
our adorable treasure, Tarumae-chan,
so how could anyone say there's nothing there?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: U-Uncle...! That's embarrassing in a whole different way...!

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since we're here, let's call everyone over!
They'll be thrilled to hear Tarumae-chan is here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah—sorry, ma'am!
I kind of want to go have lunch with my Trainer first today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll still be in Tomakomai for a while,
so I'll definitely stop by later!
I want to see everyone too.

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's fine!
I didn't want to get in the way, anyway."

text_block_list.name: Port Worker A
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Please continue to look after
Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Port Worker B
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan!
We'll send some more fish over your way next time!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You really haven't changed a bit...
choice_data_list: They were such kind people, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Everyone is so broad-minded, so warm,
and always welcomes me with a smile—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I can give it my all. ...That's why I want to give it my all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, let's head over to the restaurant!
You must be hungry too, Trainer.
After entering the shop I was looking for, I finished ordering and waited for the food to arrive—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "—Last year's Tokyo Daishoten was truly a legendary clash for the history books!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, last year's dirt—

As a recap program of last year's dirt races started playing on the in-store TV,
my eyes were naturally drawn to it, when—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Closing in from behind with 100 meters to go!!
Will Wonder Acute catch her?!
Smart Falcon digs deep and holds on!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: “—Horyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Wonder Acute!!
Smart Falcon!!
Crossing the finish line neck and neck!!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—The absolute champion, Smart Falcon,
with Wonder Acute snapping right at her heels!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Even after crossing the finish line, it was so close nobody knew who won!!
I still can't forget that excitement...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Somewhere deep in my heart, I always thought... that Falco-san would forever remain immovable at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But...
the Umamusume running at the forefront of dirt races
don't see it that way at all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Realizing once again that everyone is boldly
challenging themselves to reach the top,
just like Acute-san—

That was something I, too, was reminded of.
The front lines of dirt racing are a battleground teeming with the absolute champion and the powerhouse contenders challenging her—
In other words, a true "clash of warlords."

Therefore, for Hokko Tarumae who was heading into the Classic year,
it was obvious that countless formidable rivals
would stand in her way in the future.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...If it were the me from a while ago,
I think I would have been too scared.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm okay now.
I can feel the voices of the people of Tomakomai and all the fans much more than before, and—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...'You can definitely do it.'
I believe in those words.

A strong, dependable glimmer shone in Hokko Tarumae's eyes...!
It seemed my worries were completely unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Make the next event a success, and make an even bigger name for myself in future races...!
This year will be Hokko Tarumae's breakthrough year!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for waiting, here is your seafood bowl!
Right after declaring our New Year's resolutions, a hearty seafood bowl brimming with a variety of colorful seafood was served...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. You looked like you were enjoying your meal so much, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Tomakomai isn't just about this, you know!
Aside from the food, there are so many other wonderful things about it!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, shall we take a stroll around the city after this?
I can be your guide, as a tourism ambassador!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...! Well then, is there anywhere you'd like to go, Trainer?
Even a rough idea is totally fine, so please let me know if you have any requests!
Hearing that, what came to mind was—
choice_data_list: A place that looks fun to stroll around.
One more restaurant where you can get a delicious meal

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I know the perfect place!
It's one of my favorites—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —It's Midorigaoka Park!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Lots of nature and lots of fun facilities—this is truly a place for citizens to relax! Tomakomai's Central Park!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...When I lived back home,
I used to take walks in this park quite often, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The scenery changes with each season, making it so beautiful and calming.
Especially 'Kintaro's Pond'—
And so, listening to Hokko Tarumae's memories, we enjoyed our pleasant stroll—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But didn't you just eat?
As long as your stomach's fine, though—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, leave it to me!
I'll introduce an exquisite item that'll satisfy you, Trainer!
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's "Curry Ramen"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Great reaction, Trainer.
I promise I'll satisfy that demanding stomach of yours!

Afterward, we headed to a famous curry ramen shop
and relished the taste of Tomakomai's hometown flavor—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I know a wonderful place.
It's a personal favorite of mine—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —"Amyu," also known as the Tomakomai City Art Museum!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Just as the name suggests, it's a combined museum and art gallery where you can learn all about Tomakomai's arts, culture, and natural history all at once!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of highlights, but
first, let's start with the classic mammoth family—
Even after that, with Hokko Tarumae acting as our guide, we had a wonderful time touring the art museum—
